issues.description: DDNode dataclass field order mismatch between template and solution: in template_repository/dd.py the DDNode dataclass declares the fields in the order 'successors: list[DD]' then 'v: int' (so positional construction expects (successors, v)). However, make_dd constructs nodes with a positional call DDNode(v, successors) (template_repository/dd.py line 407). In the solution repository the DDNode dataclass declares 'v: int' then 'successors: list[DD]', matching the positional call. This mismatch will cause the positional-constructor arguments to be assigned to the wrong fields (wrong types/semantics) and will break student code that uses make_dd or constructs DDNode positionally, producing incorrect behavior or runtime errors.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the template consistent with the intended usage. Two safe fixes: (A) Reorder the DDNode dataclass fields in template_repository/dd.py to declare 'v: int' first and 'successors: list[DD]' second so positional construction DDNode(v, successors) is correct; or (B) change the constructor call in make_dd to use keywords: DDNode(v=v, successors=successors). Preferred: reorder the dataclass fields in dd.py to match the solution so students do not need to modify make_dd.
